## Change

What changed and why? Link the task or experiment.

## Evidence

Commands actually run, observed outputs, logs and environment records. State what
has not been tested. Do not claim benchmark success from repository checks alone.

## Review

- [ ] Commits contain the committing member's student ID and full name.
- [ ] Measured values are traceable and separated from templates.
- [ ] No credentials, build outputs, disk images, large traces or files over 50 MB.
- [ ] Any upstream changes are recorded and reproducible.
- [ ] Contribution/AI records are updated if applicable.

Merge/squash message: include the merging member's student ID and full name.
